name: yaps-memory
description: Private local Markdown memory across Codex chats, with focused retrieval, citations, and permission-controlled updates.

interface.shortDescription: Private local Markdown memory across Codex chats.
interface.longDescription: Requires Yaps desktop, which supplies the private local Markdown vault and MCP connection; installing the plugin alone does not create a vault. Once connected, give Codex durable cross-chat memory: search remembered facts, notes, decisions, meetings, ideas, resources, and dictation history; retrieve focused evidence with citations; capture new context; and make permission-controlled, conflict-safe edits.
defaultPrompt: Set up Yaps Memory. Check my connection, explain privacy and permissions, then guide me through my first useful action.
Help me capture a new memory in Yaps. Ask what I want to remember and where it belongs.
Summarize my five most recently updated Yaps notes and cite each note's title and path.
